description: Three constant voltage sources, each with a knob, a scale, a step switch, a step-size switch and a switch that lets it go negative

params.text: Rounds that section's output to whole steps while it is on, and lights while it is on
Lets that section's output go negative while it is on; while it is off the knob's voltage is made positive before anything else happens to it
Makes that section's steps semitones rather than whole volts while it is on, and changes nothing while that section's step switch is off
Sets that section's voltage before scaling, -1 at fully counter-clockwise to 1 fully clockwise
Multiplies that section's voltage by 0 to 10, and comes up at 1

outputs.text: That section's voltage after its knob, its scale and any stepping

notes: with the negative switch off, turning the knob counter-clockwise from the centre raises the output again rather than taking it below zero
each section's display shows the voltage its output is carrying; it is drawn rather than built from controls, so no click can reach it
